# 0nCore — The AI Business Operating System

> Customer portal for 0nMCP. The dashboards, agents, automations, the LinkedIn bot, the HIPAA scanner, and 245 CRM tools — all powered by 0nMCP.

**Product:** 0nCore (0ncore.com)
**Vendor:** RocketOpp LLC
**Stack:** Next.js 16.1.6 · React 19.2.4 · Supabase · Stripe · Anthropic + Groq · 0nMCP v4.5.1

## What it is

0nCore is the front-end to [0nMCP](https://www.npmjs.com/package/0nmcp) — the open-source 1,554-tool AI orchestrator. Where 0nMCP gives developers an MCP server, 0nCore gives operators, agencies, and small businesses a polished SaaS dashboard backed by the same engine.

## Live features

### 0nLinkedIn — AI LinkedIn growth bot
Sales page + bot dashboard + Chrome extension feature. VPIS scoring (Velocity / Patterns / Intelligence / Signals), BE writing style enforcement, K-Social Intelligence Layer for algorithm modeling.

### CRM platform (245 tools)
Full leadconnectorhq.com integration. Contacts, calendars, opportunities, invoices, social, custom objects, payments — all reachable from the dashboard or via natural-language AI chat.

### HIPAA Scanner v2
**63 baseline checks** + **6 software supply chain checks** (via Spectra Assure / secure.software integration). 4 tiers:

| Tier | Price | Output |
|------|-------|--------|
| 1 | $149 | AI Readiness Report |
| 2 | $399 | Full Compliance Report |
| 3 | $499 | Premium Audit + Booking |
| 4 | $899 | Full Concierge + Live Walkthrough |

Magic-link auth for report access. Reports stored 6 years per 164.316(b).

### Chrome extension
v4.0.0, manifest v3, 186 files. Injects AI command palette into LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Reddit, Dev.to, ProductHunt, GitHub, Medium, YouTube. Multi-AI Council (Claude / GPT / Gemini / Grok). Voice-trained content generation.

### WordPress theme + plugin downloads
v1.0.0 of the OnPress + WP-SXO plugin family for WordPress site automation.

### Multi-channel automation
Email (Resend) + LinkedIn (custom bot) + WordPress (REST) + SMS (Twilio) + Voice (HeyGen agent).

### Migration tool
"Coming from X?" with 8 platform importers — bring your existing automations from Make, Zapier, n8n, Pabbly, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, and OpenAI configs.

## AI Course Builder for GoHighLevel

**Answer:** An AI generated course in GoHighLevel is a complete membership course — modules, lessons, quizzes and resources — written by AI and published straight into a sub-account instead of typed in by hand. 0nCORE generates one from a single sentence in under five minutes.

**Page:** https://www.0ncore.com/course-builder

| Step | What happens | Time |
|------|--------------|------|
| Outline | Modules + lessons proposed for approval | Seconds |
| Generate | Every lesson written in parallel, 1,000–2,000 words each, 5-question quiz | 2–4 min |
| Publish | Lands in the GoHighLevel course system, priced and sellable | Seconds |

- Cost: included with 0nCORE. First client account free, then $5/client/month. No per-course or per-lesson fee.
- Workflow actions: `oncore_enroll_student`, `oncore_mark_complete`
- Workflow triggers: `oncore_course_completed`, `oncore_module_completed`, `oncore_student_stalled`
- Publishing requires a sub-account key. An agency token lists sub-accounts but cannot write inside one.

## 0n Course Builder — app documentation

**Answer:** 0n Course Builder is a marketplace app that turns a one-sentence description into a complete, ready-to-sell course inside your own account — outline, full lesson bodies and a five-question quiz per lesson — published natively where you can edit and price it like a course you built by hand.

**Page:** https://www.0ncore.com/docs/course-builder

| Permission | Access | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Write courses | Write | Saves the finished course into your account's course area |
| Read location | Read only | Identifies which sub-account the app was opened from |

- It requests exactly two permissions. It does NOT read contacts, conversations, calendars, payments, opportunities or workflows.
- No separate signup and no second login — it authenticates through the account it is installed in.
- Nothing is written to the account until the user presses Publish. The outline is an approval gate.
- Uninstalling leaves published courses in place; they belong to the account.
- Built and supported by RocketOpp LLC, Pennsylvania, USA. mike@rocketopp.com · +1-724-238-9800.
